title: Threshold sign of a natural number plus sign sum
statement: For natural numbers $k,m$ and a sign vector $y\\in\\{-1,1\\}^m$, the threshold sign of $k+\\sum_{j=0}^{m-1}y_j$ is $1$ if and only if $-(k+1)<\\sum_{j=0}^{m-1}y_j$, where the sum on the right is taken in the integers.
